selection: TRAIN only; count mentions from role inputs first, retain8..13; take first32 by(id_hash,index), keep all selected cases incl failures; no target/output/rank selection
preconditions: Full complex mention rank8 at existing1e-10 relative cutoff; nonempty context; J singular min/max>=1e-6; projected energy and class0 logit ratios>=1e-8
positive: constraint infinity residual<=1e-12 AND energy delta<-1e-10 AND actual source-dtype relative class0 logit absolute delta>=1e-6
gate: At least one positive = bounded real-state existence; report all selected/eligible/train denominators
stop: No extension of cohort, step, thresholds or iterations after results. Zero positives close this fixed no-fit construction in its tested domain; not a global phase-uniqueness or utility rejection
claim_scope: Frozen trained native state port on development TRAIN inputs; no label-directed improvement, full-data utility, new trained method, shallow-circuit realization or inherited L4/L5
execution: CPU1/4GB after current task quiescent via existing shared scheduler; no current-run mutation
